name: City of Richmond Department of Public Utilities (Richmond WWTP and combined sewer system)
outfalls_source: ECHO National CSO Inventory (25 CSO + 4 closed rows, raw/echo-cso-inventory-va.json); operator points in the EmNet map (raw/richmond/emnet/sites-2026-11-02.json); DEQ EDMA VPDES Outfalls layer 119
notification_channel: Public CSO map https://apps.emnet.net/richmond-pub-map-app/?city=47&config=5c0cacee-7e95-4eea-922d-c736c83eb4b9 (red for 48 h after the last overflow at each of 25 monitored outfalls); monthly per-outfall XLSX reports at https://www.rva.gov/public-utilities/csooutfalls; signs at outfalls. 'CSO overflow email notifications are no longer provided'.
notes: Integrated VPDES permit (WWTP, CSS, MS4) effective 2025-09-01, expires 2030-08-31; Part III 1.h public notification = signs, website, meetings, press. 2020 Acts ch. 634: final plan construction complete by July 1, 2035. CSO Final Plan approved by DEQ August 2024. July 2026: 287.0 MG observed overflow. PReP = DEQ Pollution Response Program reports with SEWAGE_RELATED='Y' since 2025-01-01 (export layer, queried 2026-11-02). 8 on this permit (1.92 million gallons), 20 with 'Richmond' in the name.

name: City of Lynchburg Water Resources (Lynchburg Regional Wastewater Treatment Plant)
outfalls_source: ECHO National CSO Inventory (17 CSO rows); city layers https://utility.arcgis.com/usrsvcs/servers/62329509147e4d049cca02c02233c595/rest/services/WaterResources/SanitarySewer_UN/MapServer/345 (15 discharge locations) and /344 (18 overflow manholes)
notification_channel: Lynchburg Alerts (Everbridge) text/email: alert when a monitored CSO to the James overflows and a second alert 'Thirty hours after the overflow ends'. Sign-up https://www.lynchburgva.gov/626/Lynchburg-Alerts. CSO page https://www.lynchburgva.gov/513/Combined-Sewer-Overflow-System-CSO.
notes: City: 115 of 132 original overflow points closed or being closed; downtown CSO tunnel blasting finished July 2026 (WDBJ). Permit expires 2030-11-30. PReP = DEQ Pollution Response Program reports with SEWAGE_RELATED='Y' since 2025-01-01 (export layer, queried 2026-11-02). 34 naming Lynchburg; one CSO-named record (319811, 2025-07-14, James River).

name: Alexandria Renew Enterprises (AlexRenew WRRF and Alexandria combined sewer outfalls)
